smell: baseUrl is modeled as broad S.String even though the service immediately normalizes it into the existing branded URLStr schema before constructing the SDK client.
proposedTarget: Move URL precision to the config schema by using URLStr after the trailing-slash normalization codec or by introducing a PhoenixBaseUrl schema that trims trailing slashes and brands via URLStr; URLStr is the in-repo schema at packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/URL.ts:44-54 and is already the resolved field type at Phoenix.service.ts:129.

exception.reason: Trailing-slash normalization moved into PhoenixConfigInput, but making the exported config constructor require branded URLStr would force out-of-package callers such as the AgentEffectiveness CLI to brand plain string flags.
exception.boundary: cross-package ripple, deferred to family-close sweep

smell: HTTP/SDK payload records use S.Record(S.String, S.Unknown), which admits non-JSON values even though Phoenix dataset inputs, outputs, and metadata are serialized API payloads.
proposedTarget: Use S.Record(S.String, S.Json) or the repo JsonObject schema for dataset input/output/metadata and experiment/prompt/annotation metadata; S.Json is verified at .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:14064, and repo JSON object wrappers live at packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/Json.ts:27.

exception.reason: Tightening public payload records from unknown values to Json would require @beep/repo-ai-metrics payload model and forwarding changes; that package currently exposes and forwards Record<string, unknown> examples.
exception.boundary: cross-package ripple, deferred to family-close sweep

smell: Phoenix ids, names, labels, tags, model names, and version ids are modeled as broad S.String across selectors, write results, prompt inputs, annotation inputs, and experiment results, allowing empty strings at the schema boundary.
proposedTarget: Introduce named non-empty string schemas for PhoenixId, PhoenixName, PhoenixVersionId, and PhoenixTag using S.NonEmptyString (verified at .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:8420) or narrower checks where the SDK documents a format, then reuse them on datasetId/value/versionId/promptVersionId/experimentId/targetId/name/modelName fields.

exception.reason: Branding exported Phoenix ids/names/tags/version strings as non-empty would change constructor input types for current out-of-package Phoenix consumers and requires a coordinated consumer sweep.
exception.boundary: cross-package ripple, deferred to family-close sweep
